The clinical practice surrounding atrial fibrillation (AF) in [[danmark|Danmark]] encompasses pharmacological interventions, specifically [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]], and structured [[patientuddannelse|Patientuddannelse]]. These practices are closely monitored across the Danish regions to ensure a high quality of care and to mitigate severe complications such as [[iskæmisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke). Much of the national data tracking these practices is drawn from the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] registry.

A major focus of clinical practice is the timely initiation of [[antikoagulationsbehandling|antikoagulationsbehandling]]. According to registry data, 55.6% of patients started this treatment within four months prior to their diagnosis, while 44.4% initiated it within 30 days after discharge [^src1]. Looking at broader national figures, 8,129 patients in [[danmark|Danmark]] started anticoagulation treatment within four months before diagnosis, representing 53.1% of all patients receiving this therapy [^src4]. Regional variations exist in these pre-diagnosis initiation rates: [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] had the highest proportion at 56.3% (1,970 patients), followed by [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] at 55.1% (952 patients), [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] at 53.7% (1,900 patients), [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] at 50.6% (2,086 patients), and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] at 50.5% (1,221 patients) [^src4].

Another critical quality metric, [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]], evaluates the use of anticoagulation among AF patients who suffer an [[iskæmisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]]. Nationally, 64.8% of AF patients admitted with an ischemic stroke had redeemed an anticoagulation prescription within 100 days prior to their admission date [^src2]. Further detailed analysis shows that out of all AF patients admitted with an ischemic stroke or a stroke of unknown type, 772 (67.3%) in [[danmark|Danmark]] had redeemed a prescription for oral anticoagulation within 100 days before admission [^src4]. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] led the regions in this metric with 75.4% (92 patients), followed by [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] at 73.5% (183 patients), [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] at 67.7% (132 patients), [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] at 64.8% (248 patients), and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] at 59.1% (117 patients) [^src4].

Beyond pharmacotherapy, [[patientuddannelse|Patientuddannelse]] is a vital component of holistic clinical practice. At [[herlev-og-gentofte-hospital|Herlev og Gentofte Hospital]], group education sessions last 2.5 hours and include either 14-16 patients with relatives or larger groups of up to 35 patients with relatives [^src3]. The curriculum covers anatomy, physiology, causes of AF, stroke risk, lifestyle, and living with the disease, and is led by one or two arrhythmia nurses [^src3]. A cardiologist also participates for about 30 minutes, focusing specifically on the medical treatment of AF [^src3]. On a broader theoretical level, patient education should be anchored in a theoretical model and conducted in active collaboration between the patient, relatives, and healthcare professionals [^src5]. Effective methods primarily include individual and group teaching, lasting between 30 and 150 minutes per session, with follow-ups occurring 1 to 5 times every 2 to 3 months over a period of up to 24 months [^src5].

- Start på antikoagulationsbehandling: 55,6 % af patienterne startede behandlingen inden for 4 måneder før diagnose, mens 44,4 % startede inden for 30 dage efter udskrivelse [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, antikoagulationsbehandling)

  Page: 71

- 64,8% af atrieflimren patienter der var indlagt med iskæmisk apopleksi havde indløst AK-behandling indenfor 100 dage før indlæggelsesdatoen [^src1] (indikator-5)
  Type: clinical-practice
  Page: 39
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2025.pdf, pages 36-40

  Type: clinical-practice
  Page: 57
